dct_creator_sm: Mason, Georgia (Department of Animal Biosciences. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: Mink behaviour, welfare and reproductive success: comparison between non-enriched and enriched housing. This study investigated how a practical enrichment program on North American farms affected mink welfare over the course of their annual cycle. The project began with a pilot study on two farms to assess the practicality and cost of a wide range of possible enrichments, followed by a more comprehensive experiment expanded to three farms to collect more detailed data, including data on reproductive variables.
